summary: This bill requires all immigration detention facilities, including those operated by private entities, to adhere to the Federal Performance Based Detention Standards published by the U.S. Marshal Service.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that all immigration detention facilities adhere to the Federal Performance Based Detention Standards, which are typically applied to U.S. Marshal Service facilities. While it doesn't directly change immigration policy or border security, it affects the conditions under which individuals detained under immigration laws are held, potentially making detention more standardized and secure. This indirectly supports the 'Secure Borders' aspect by ensuring consistent and potentially more rigorous detention standards for those apprehended.
